newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm, seen consolidating.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm, seen consolidating.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures pared early losses to end firmer on arbitrage buying on Thursday, but dealers said the market was likely to run into some resistance soon.
"There was a quite a good fight before it came back up," said a trader with a local futures house. He said there was strong buying interest in the December Nikkei between 20,500 and 21,000 points.
After opening weak on the dollar's steep overnight drop and the Dow's decline, the benchark Nikkei 225 December contract finished at 21,320 against a previous 21,200.

The trader said the contract's close above 21,250 boded well for further gains, but it would have trouble climbing above 21,500. "The upside's looking a bit toppish. I think 21,500 should be a good psychological resistance."

A trader with a U.S. house said the dollar's weakness against the yen was likely to be short-lived and the Nikkei would derive support from it once it climbed back above 110 yen. -- Sonali Desai (65-8703090)
